# CSGN

> A 24-hour crypto television channel that anyone can get on. Members post links
> to clips they already made, and those clips air between live streams. Streamers
> connect their Twitch channel once and are carried automatically whenever they
> go live. Airtime is allocated one-to-one with the $CSGN a member holds.

CSGN (Crypto Sports & Gaming Network) is a continuously broadcasting channel
rather than a video platform. There is no feed and no algorithm — there is one
channel, and at any moment it is showing exactly one thing.

## What it actually does

- **Clips.** A member pastes a link to an existing YouTube, TikTok or Instagram
  post. Nothing is uploaded to CSGN — the platform that already hosts the video
  keeps hosting it. A human reviews every clip before it can air.
- **Live streams.** A member connects a Twitch channel and grants permission for
  CSGN to re-broadcast it. CSGN samples every consenting channel about once a
  minute; when a member is live, an operator can put them on the network in one
  click. Nobody books a time slot.
- **Airtime.** The share of the channel's open air a member is entitled to is
  their share of the circulating $CSGN supply, one to one, capped so no single
  holder can take the whole channel. It is calculated from the wallet balance
  read live from Solana, not from a stored snapshot and not from how much the
  member posts.
- **Fees.** Streamers earn a share of $CSGN trading fees for the minutes they
  were actually carried on the CSGN channel — not for being live on their own
  channel, and not for reserving a block they did not show up for.

## Key facts

- Chain: Solana. Token: $CSGN, mint `GFV7fphvprMr1PYpYGPJort2QP7JJLEp3J1Buu7Zpump`
- The token never gates having an account, connecting a channel, or going live.
  Those are free. It determines promotion: clip airtime share, broadcast ticker
  access, vote weight, and the coin spotlight auction.
- Nothing is burned, staked, locked or escrowed. Voting and airtime weight are
  simply the wallet's current on-chain balance.
- Source code is MIT licensed at https://github.com/csgnet-web/csgn

## Pages

- [Watch](https://csgn.fun/watch): the live channel
- [Schedule](https://csgn.fun/schedule): who is on the network right now, and what aired
- [Studio](https://csgn.fun/studio): post a clip, see your airtime
- [$CSGN](https://csgn.fun/participate): the Meme 100 board, network votes, the coin jukebox
- [Treasury](https://csgn.fun/treasury): where the money goes, published
- [About](https://csgn.fun/about): the full explanation
- [Terms](https://csgn.fun/terms) · [Privacy](https://csgn.fun/privacy)

## What CSGN is not

- Not a video hosting service. It stores links, not files.
- Not a social feed. There is one channel and one thing on it at a time.
- Not a staking or yield product. Holding is not depositing.
